tasks.instruction: Read AGENTS.md/WORKING_RULES then only SPHERICAL_CURVE_ERROR.md, SPHERICAL_ROOT_PRECISION.md, engine/geometry/connected-shader.js solve/sweep, additive-event-order.js. Bounded independent review, no code fixes: identify what must be proved to replace S3 ball tangency refusals with ordered entry bands. Specifically audit whether amplitude-only shared-sincos error supplies phase/time bounds (it does not generally), whether firstAdditiveEntry can be reused given certified outside starts and portal-horizon events, and whether selecting a root-band midpoint alone certifies the shaded hit point/normal. Propose the smallest safe integration reusing existing H3 event-band machinery; list exact missing assumptions and do not claim new numerical constants proven. Output <=600 words in sole allowed report. <=15 targeted tool calls; no full suites/browser, broad archives, commits, subagents or followups. If quota blocks stop. This is review for lead, not implementation or authorization to recolor unresolved pixels.
